description: This file defines the `NotesProvider` class, a ChangeNotifier in a Flutter application that manages per-recipe notes stored locally using SharedPreferences. It provides methods to load all notes, retrieve notes for specific recipes, and set or clear notes with persistence.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages local per-recipe notes with persistent storage using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Loads all saved notes from SharedPreferences into the in-memory cache.

methods.name: getNoteFor
methods.description: Returns the note text for a specified recipe ID, or an empty string if none exists.

methods.name: setNoteFor
methods.description: Sets or clears the note for a specified recipe ID and updates SharedPreferences accordingly.
